]]> Five Year Anniversary Homicide Death of De’Joshua Johnson https://www.pbso.org/five-year-anniversary-homicide-death-of-dejoshua-johnson Wed, 07 Oct 2026 19:48:12 +0000 http://aw-pbsowww-s1.pbso.org/?p=38387 PBSO Detectives and the family of De’Joshua Johnson are seeking the public’s assistance with ANY information on this shooting/homicide incident.  Originally the family invoked Marsy’s Law, however, it has now been recinded.

ANYONE with information is urged to contact Crime Stoppers at 1-800-458-TIPS.

 

November 10, 2021*

Today, November 10, 2021, one of the three victims succumbed to his injuries.  The victim was an adult male, 31 years of age from Greenacres.  His family invoked Marsy’s Law, therefore, his name will not be released.

Detectives are now investigating this shooting as a homicide.

Anyone with information on this shooting is urged to contact Crime Stoppers at 1-800-458-TIPS.

 

November 7, 2021

Date:           Saturday, November 6, 2021

Time:          10:05 pm

Location:    S. Lake Ave/Daniel Place, Pahokee

Deputies attempted to break up a large block party in the area of S. Lake Ave and Daniel Place when gunshots were heard.  When the crowd eventually dispersed deputies located three victims suffering from gunshot wounds; two adult males and one adult female.  All three victims were transported to an area hospital for treatment.  One is listed in critical condition, one is listed in serious condition and one received non-life threatening injuries.

Detectives from the Violent Crimes Division arrived on scene to investigate further.  No suspect or motive is known at this time.

Anyone with information on this shooting is urged to contact Crime Stoppers at 1-800-458-TIPS.

]]> Seeking Information on a Hit and Run from 9-9-2026 https://www.pbso.org/seeking-information-on-a-hit-and-run-from-9-9-2026 Fri, 02 Oct 2026 18:48:41 +0000 http://aw-pbsowww-s1.pbso.org/?p=38358 On September 9, 2026 at approximately 1:20pm, the depicted vehicle struck a pedestrian in the Publix parking lot at 12425 Hagen Ranch Rd, Boynton Beach.

After the collision, the driver exited the vehicle, spoke to the victim, and then left the area without rendering aid or providing any information.

Anyone with information regarding the identity or whereabouts of these “persons of interest” is urged to contact Crime Stoppers at 1-800-458-TIPS (8477) or remain anonymous by downloading the PBSO app, available for Apple and Android smartphones.
